title: Keep going while…
concept: Repeat a block while a condition is True, so one program fits any size

steps.say: Run it: `range(5)` is 5 moves, but this corridor needs 7.
`while` keeps moving as long as `front_is_clear()` is True.
A 1-cell corridor: the wall is right there. Run it: the loop runs 0 times.
`while gems_here():` repeats until the cell is empty. Run it.
After `move()`, look at the cell: add `if gems_here():` with `pick()` inside the loop.
A pile needs more than one `pick()`. Change `if` to `while`.
Run it in every corridor. A gem left behind? Look where in the loop you check the cell.

guided.done: Every pile cleared, in corridors of any length.

recap.say: `while condition:` repeats its block until the condition is False.

piles: Look at the cell the robot starts on: does it still have gems at the end?
`if` picks one gem. What repeats until a cell is empty? And which cell does your loop never look at?
follow_trail: Look where the robot must stop in the Goal view: just past the last gem, not at the wall.
What is true on every cell of the trail, but false on the first cell after it? Loop on that, not on the wall.
